hull_geometry: Broad, slab-sided rectangular hull with a symmetrical, blocky profile; features a large central 'gate' or hangar opening at the prow
materials_and_finish: Rough, pitted metal with visible rivet patterns and heavy-duty structural reinforcement beams; numerous rectangular cargo or weapon pods
design_philosophy: Emphasizes interior volume and heavy armor over mobility or sensor stealth; looks like an interstellar fortress
color_scheme: Industrial bronze and weathered iron plating; very few external lights, primarily red thruster glows at the rear and amber safety strobes
distinctive_traits: The sheer mass and brutalist architecture suggest a race with vast resources and a focus on siege warfare
